description.value: Showshaa is a first-of-its-kind casual Indian dining taproom in Surrey, serving creative tapas-style eats, kebabs, sizzlers, and Indian street food alongside a curated selection of local and international beers, wines, and cocktails. The name comes from a casual Indian term for 'showbiz,' and the concept leans into that with contemporary interiors and a patio described as offering a 'stunning view.' The wide menu spans Indian street food, grilled mains, biryanis, and handhelds, with clearly marked vegetarian and vegan-friendly options throughout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active casual Indian taproom at the OSM address. The contact page corroborates the address and provides a phone number absent from OSM; the menu explicitly marks vegetarian (V) and vegan-friendly (VF) items, and an 'Order Online' button confirms takeout availability. No information about bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Phone number (+1 778-294-9885) is sourced from the website only; OSM has no phone entry, so cross-confirmation is not possible.
OSM source data is from City of Surrey 2010 GIS with an address record dated 2004-03-29 — the OSM record is very old and may not reflect current business details.
No bike parking, water refill, or washroom information found anywhere on the website — all required criteria are unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Showshaa is a legitimate, active food and drink business with takeout and vegetarian/vegan options that would appeal to touring cyclists, but no bike parking of any kind is confirmed, which is a required criterion for a WWC listing. A site visit or direct inquiry is needed to determine whether bike parking or rack access exists before including.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Happy hours menu footer explicitly notes 'V- VEGETARIAN' and 'VF – VEGAN FRIENDLY' designations; multiple menu items (e.g. Veggie Pakora, Sesame Paneer Fingers, Butter Paneer, Veg Mains section) are present throughout

wow_evidence: first-of-its-kind casual Indian dining taproom in Surrey

price.label: Casual
price.signal: Street eats menu items $14.99–$17.00; sit-down taproom, not quick-service
